name: Feint
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has an extra 25% chance of inflicting a critical hit.

name: Dreadtone
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Transfers all debuffs from this Champion to the target before the attack. This effect cannot be resisted by Bosses. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff for 1 turn. This debuff cannot be resisted by Bosses.

name: Seismic Dissonance
description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. 

After the first hit, has a 75% chance of placing a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff and a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. These debuffs cannot be resisted by Bosses. 

After the second hit, has a 75% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ACC]</color> debuff and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease RES]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. These debuffs cannot be resisted by Bosses.

name: Mindless Muscle
description: Places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff and an <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Taunt]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. If a Boss is present in the current Round, these buffs are protected.

name: Drone of Agony [P]
description: Whenever this Champion places a debuff on an enemy, deals damage equal to 1% of their MAX HP for each debuff they are currently under. (Stacks up to 10%). Occurs once per skill and once per target.

name: Poisonous Lily
description: Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit has a 35% chance of placing a 2.5% <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Bejeweled Club
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 40% chance of decreasing the cooldown of a random ally's skill by 1 turn. Cannot decrease this Champion's cooldowns.

Also heals the ally who had their skill cooldown decreased by 10% of this Champion's MAX HP.

name: Primeval Secret
description: Places an <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buff and a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on a single ally for 2 turns. Also decreases the cooldown of all that ally's skills by 2 turns. This skill's cooldown cannot be decreased or reset.

name: Coccoon of Revival
description:
Revives a single ally with 50% HP and 75% Turn Meter. 

Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff and a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on that ally for 2 turns.

name: Temporal Scholar [P]
description: Whenever an enemy Champion’s passive skill activates, fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 30%. Occurs once per turn.

name: Lead the Charge
description: Attacks 1 enemy with 2 random allies. Allies joining the attack use their default skills.

name: Ax Pirouette
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

Each hit will ignore 10% of the target’s DEF. Each critical hit has a 75% chance of stealing 1 random buff from the target.

name: Shatter Limbs
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

The damage inflicted by this skill increases by 10% for each debuff on the target (stacks up to 100%). 

Each hit has a 75% chance of placing a 100% <color=#1ee600>[Heal Reduction]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: For Hrothglime!
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Has a 40% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn.

name: Fight Dirty [P]
description:
Allies deal 15% more damage to targets under a <color=#1ee600>[Heal Reduction]</color> or a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff placed by this Champion. 

If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Poisonous Lily
description: Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit has a 35% chance of placing a 5% <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Phantom Pack
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

Each hit has a 35% chance of placing a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Ghostly Roots
description:
Attack all enemies. 

Has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn.

name: Arooo!
description: Places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. Also places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Safety in Numbers [P]
description: Decreases the damage this Champion receives by 5% for each ally under an <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff placed by this Champion.

name: You're Barred!
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

Each hit has a 75% chance of removing 1 random buff from the target. 

Each hit will ignore 20% of the target’s DEF.

name: Geode Haymaker
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ACC]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff and a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns.

name: Demolisher Blow
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, removes all debuffs from this Champion and places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Shatter]</color> buff and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.  

Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs. If the target is not under any <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs, this attack will deal 100% more damage.

Grants an Extra Turn if this attack kills an enemy.

name: Stonefaced [P]
description:
At the start of this Champion's turn, removes any <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Petrification]</color> debuffs from this Champion. 

Increases this Champion's damage inflicted against targets with no buffs on them by 20%.

name: Wrist Blades
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Heals this Champion by 30% of the damage dealt.

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color> 

Whenever this Champion successfully <color=#1ee600>Evades</color> an enemy skill and all of its accompanying effects, counterattacks with this skill. Occurs once per turn.

name: Smart Disc
description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. After hitting the initially selected enemy, all other enemies will be hit in a random order. For the first hit, the damage received by the initially selected enemy will be increased by 75%. Each subsequent enemy hit following the initial hit will receive 15% less bonus damage (reduces to 15% bonus damage). Also destroys each enemy's MAX HP by 30% of the damage dealt (stacks up to 50%).

For the second hit, the damage received by the initially selected enemy will be increased by 15%. Each subsequent enemy hit following the initial hit will receive 15% more bonus damage (stacks up to 75% bonus damage).

This attack ignores 15% of each target's DEF if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Veil]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff.

name: Combistick Throw
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, places a <color=#1ee600>[Hunter's Gaze]</color> debuff for 1 turn. This debuff cannot be resisted if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Veil]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff.

If this attack kills an enemy, places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Revive]</color> debuff on the target and a <color=#1ee600>[Hunter's Gaze]</color> debuff on a random alive enemy for 1 turn. The <color=#1ee600>[Hunter's Gaze]</color> debuff cannot be resisted if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Veil]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff.

If this attack does not kill an enemy, places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns and fills their Turn Meter by 50%.

name: Yautja Cloak [P]
description:
At the start of each Round, places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn. 

Before this Champion takes a turn, also has an initial 50% chance to <color=#1ee600>Evade</color> an enemy skill and all of its accompanying effects. This initial chance reduces to 0% after this Champion's first turn in a Round.

Whenever this Champion kills an enemy, grants this Champion a 20% chance to <color=#1ee600>Evade</color> enemy skills and accompanying effects (stacks up to 60%).

name: Skill 100605 name
description: Skill 8000628 description

name: Edenic Blades
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff for 2 turns. Steals 5% of the target’s Turn Meter for each buff on them.

name: Shackle The Unjust
description:
Removes all buffs from all enemies. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a 100% <color=#1ee600>[Ensnare]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. This debuff will ignore any <color=#1ee600>[Block Debuffs]</color> buffs on enemies under 3 or more buffs. 

Also decreases the Turn Meters of all enemies by 25%. If an enemy is under 3 or more buffs, will decrease their Turn Meter by 40% instead.

name: Ethereal Benediction
description:
Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ACC]</color> buff for 2 turns and 1 <color=#1ee600>[Intercept]</color> stack on all allies. Also fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 25%. 

Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Your Eminence [P]
description:
Allies receive 25% less damage from enemies under <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Veil]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color>, or <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> buffs.

Each time an enemy receives a buff, is healed, or has their Turn Meter filled, has a 50% chance to decrease the duration of all their buffs by 1 turn. Occurs once per skill and once per target.

If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Hematic Blades
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

Each hit has a 33% chance of granting an Extra Turn. Cannot gain more than one Extra Turn. Cannot gain an Extra Turn if the target is a Boss.

name: Sanguine Fissure
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Will ignore 33% of the target’s DEF. Will ignore 99% of the target’s DEF, <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs instead if this skill is used on a Turn number that is divisible by 3. 

If the target is killed, increases the cooldowns of all enemy skills by 3 turns. This effect cannot be resisted if this skill is used on a Turn number that is divisible by 3.

name: Gorescream
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, removes all buffs from all enemies. This effect cannot be resisted by enemies with a number of buffs that is divisible by 3. Will attack all remaining enemies with less than 66% HP.  

Grants an Extra Turn if this Champion is under a number of buffs that is divisible by 3.

name: Say Her Name [P]
description:
Each subsequent hit from this Champion deals 33% more damage (stacks up to 99%). Resets after the 99% damage bonus is applied. 

Each subsequent hit this Champion receives deals 33% (11% from Bosses) less damage. Stacks up to 3 times. Resets after the damage reduction is applied for the third time.

Whenever an enemy is revived, revives this Champion with 33% HP and 66% Turn Meter. After being revived, places a <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted or blocked.

name: Links Of Death
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 50% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff and a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuff for 1 turn.

name: Wretched Guillotine
description:
Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn. 

Places a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff and a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is proportional to this Champion's DEF.

name: You Stand Accused
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Life Barrier]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Poison Cloud]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs, as well as 25% of the target's DEF. 

If the target was killed by this skill, revives a random dead ally with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter. This revive will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Block Revive]</color> debuffs. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Revive]</color> debuff on targets killed by this skill.

name: Fallen Legend [P]
description: Whenever this Champion kills an enemy or decapitates a Hydra Head, fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 25% and heals them by 25% of their MAX HP.

name: Master Wills It [P]
description:
Whenever an enemy is revived, instantly activates the <color=#1ee600>You Stand Accused</color> skill against that enemy. If multiple enemies are revived, the initial target of the revive will be targeted by the <color=#1ee600>You Stand Accused</color> skill. Will not put the <color=#1ee600>You Stand Accused</color> skill on cooldown. 

Has a 50% chance of activating the <color=#1ee600>You Stand Accused</color> skill on an enemy whenever an ally is killed. Occurs once per turn. 

Instantly activates the <color=#1ee600>You Stand Accused</color> skill against a Hydra Head whenever an ally is devoured by that Head. Will not put the <color=#1ee600>You Stand Accused</color> skill on cooldown.

If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Pierce
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 40% chance of placing a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Reflect Damage]</color> buff on a random ally for 2 turns.

name: Torturous Bolts
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

Each hit has a 50% chance of placing a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Purge The Impure
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, removes all buffs from all enemies. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff and a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns.

name: Mother Knows Best
description:
Revives all dead allies with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter. If all other allies are dead, revives them with 75% HP and 75% Turn Meter instead, and decreases the cooldown of all revived ally skills by 1 turn. 

Also increases the cooldown of all enemy skills by 2 turns.

name: Warped Benevolence [P]
description:
Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 20% whenever an ally dies. 

Heals this Champion by 20% of their MAX HP whenever they are attacked by an enemy under a <color=#1ee600>[Pain Link]</color> debuff. Occurs once per turn. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Pain Link]</color> debuff for 2 turns on enemies who deal damage equal to 25% or more of an ally’s MAX HP with a single skill. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Rend
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff on all allies for 1 turn if this attack is critical.

name: Hail
description: Attacks all enemies 3 times. Has a 50% chance to decrease the Turn Meter by 30%.

name: Warcry
description: Places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. Fills the Turn Meter of all allies by 25%.

name: Vineblades
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Each hit has a 25% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Horrifying Visage
description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. 

The first hit has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color> debuff for 1 turn. The second hit has a 75% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ACC]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: One With Corruption
description:
Places a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase RES]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Dark Sustenance [P]
description: Before this Champion uses a skill to deal damage, heals this Champion. The value of the heal is proportional to this Champion’s DEF.

name: Tail Stab
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Places a 5% <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuff for 2 turns. Places three 5% <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuffs if this attack is critical.

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Infestation
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, places a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff and an <color=#1ee600>[Infest]</color> debuff on the target for 2 turns. These debuffs cannot be resisted if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff on all other enemies for 1 turn. This debuff cannot be resisted if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff.

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color> 

Revives this Champion with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter whenever an enemy under an <color=#1ee600>[Infest]</color> debuff dies.

name: Rip and Claw
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Deals 15% more damage for each <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuff on the target.

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Caustic Blood [P]
description:
Whenever this Champion is attacked, has a 25% chance to place a 5% <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuff on the attacker for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted or blocked if the attack is critical.

If an enemy is under a <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuff placed by this Champion, decreases their DEF by 20%.

name: Infestation
description: Skill 8000628 description

name: Pulverizing Pummel
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

Each hit has a 30% chance of decreasing the detonation countdown of all <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuffs on the target by 1 turn. 

Also has a 30% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff on the target for 1 turn.

name: Battlefield Sapper
description:
Has a 75% chance of placing 2 <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuffs on each enemy that detonate after 2 turns. The damage dealt by the <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuffs is based on this Champion's ATK.

Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 25% for each enemy with a <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuff.

name: Mangonel Maul
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Has a 75% chance of decreasing the detonation countdown of all <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuffs by 1 turn. 

Also has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Bomb Breacher [P]
description:
Fills all allies’ Turn Meters by 5% each time a <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuff detonates. 

Has a 20% chance of activating an <color=#1ee600>[Instant Turn]</color> effect on this Champion whenever an ally or an enemy is killed by a <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuff.

name: Beheading Strike
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, decreases the duration of all buffs on the target by 1 turn. 

Also has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff for 2 turns. This debuff is protected when placed on Bosses.

name: Gaellen Fury
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn and a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff for 2 turns. 

Decreases the Turn Meters of enemies without a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff by 30%.

name: Blood Of The Pact
description:
Removes all debuffs from all allies, then heals them by 25% of this Champion’s MAX HP. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff, equal to 25% of this Champion’s MAX HP, and a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Fortify]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Freedom Or Death [P]
description:
For every 10 debuffs this Champion's team receives, activates the <color=#1ee600>Blood Of The Pact</color> skill. When activated in this way, the buffs placed by the <color=#1ee600>Blood Of The Pact</color> skill are protected. Does not set the <color=#1ee600>Blood Of The Pact</color> skill on cooldown. 

If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

description: Skill 8000628 description

name: Dual Slash
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Each critical hit will ignore 5% of the target's DEF.

name: Sword Plunge
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn. 

Will attack all other enemies if this Champion is under an <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff. Will not place <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuffs against all other enemies.

name: Enmeshing Barrage
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff and a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Each critical hit fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 5%.

name: Restorative Slash

This attack is always critical if <color=#F3BC02>Noldua the Gloaming</color> is on the same team. Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> buffs. 

This Champion receives 75% less damage on enemy Extra Turns or <color=#1ee600>[Instant Turn]</color>s while this skill is not on cooldown. 

While this skill is on cooldown, reduces the cooldown by 1 turn whenever an enemy receives an Extra Turn, has an <color=#1ee600>[Instant Turn]</color> activated on them, or has their Turn Meter increased. Occurs once per turn.

name: Scholar Of Sun [P]
description:
Whenever an enemy receives healing, has a 100% chance to reduce the amount of healing received to zero. This Champion will receive that healing instead. If <color=#F3BC02>Noldua the Gloaming</color> is on the same team, enemies will receive damage equal to the amount of healing instead. This effect does not work against Bosses.

Once per Round, if this Champion is dead, revives this Champion with 100% HP and 100% Turn Meter when their last living ally is killed. Then places a <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> is equal to 300% of this Champion’s MAX HP. If <color=#F3BC02>Noldua the Gloaming</color> is on the same team, this buff is protected.

name: Skill 103205 name
description: Skill 9000017 description

name: Raging River
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Before attacking, has a 50% chance of removing all buffs from the target. Has a 100% chance to steal all buffs instead if this skill is used not on this Champion’s turn. This effect cannot be resisted by targets whose ATK is equal to or lower than this Champion’s. 

Will ignore 5% of the target’s DEF for each buff on this Champion.

name: Erosive Force
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff and a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Shatter]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> buffs. 

Grants an Extra Turn if this attack kills an enemy. If the target survives, fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 30% instead.

name: Meltwater Flood
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, has a 75% chance of placing a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted by targets whose ATK is equal to or lower than this Champion’s. Will ignore 25% of each target's DEF. 

Places an extra hit on enemies whose ATK is equal to or lower than this Champion’s. 

Places an <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> and a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Student Of Glaicad [P]
description:
Has a 50% chance to deal 100% more damage against enemies whose ATK is equal to or lower than this Champion’s. 

This Champion receives 30% less damage from enemies whose ATK is equal to or lower than this Champion’s.

name: Aqueuos Bolt
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Each hit heals the ally with the lowest HP by 5% of this Champion’s MAX HP.

name: Tidemaster's Wrath
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Places a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Rejuvenating Waters
description:
Revives 2 random allies with 40% HP and 20% Turn Meter. 

Heals all allies by 15% of this Champion’s MAX HP. Will heal all allies even if no allies were revived. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 1 turn. Will place the buff even if no allies were revived.

name: Safety of the Waves [P]
description: At the start of this Champion's turn, places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff for 1 turn on all allies whose HP is less than 100%. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is equal to 15% of the receiving Champion’s MAX HP.

name: Pride Strike
description:
Attacks 1 enemy.  

Places an extra hit if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff.  

Decreases the target’s Turn Meter by 10%.

name: Apex Slice
description:
Attacks 1 enemy.  

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Revive]</color> debuff if the target is killed. 

Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 30%.

name: Aspirant of Theosomi
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Will ignore 15% of the target’s DEF if they are Spirit Affinity. Will ignore 25% of the target’s DEF if they are any other Affinity. 

Activates the <color=#1ee600>Apex Slice</color> skill on a random enemy whose HP was decreased by more than 50% from this skill. Occurs once per skill.

name: Lionsguard Lessons [P]
description: Before attacking, has a 25% chance of removing any <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuffs on this Champion and replacing them with their mirrored buff equivalent. Also has a 25% chance of removing any <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buffs on enemies and replacing them with their mirrored debuff equivalent.

name: Staggering Strike
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 15% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn.

name: Stance of Steel
description:
Places a <color=#1ee600>[Taunt]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn. 

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns, equal to 15% of this Champion’s MAX HP.

name: Military Discipline [P]
description: Whenever this Champion is attacked, has a 5% chance of decreasing all incoming damage to zero.

name: Hatespine
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Will repeat the attack against the enemy with the highest Turn Meter if the initial target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff.

name: Crimson Steel
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn, and decreases the Turn Meters of all enemies by 50%. These effects cannot be resisted by targets whose ATK is lower than this Champion’s.

name: Hemaelstrom
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, removes all buffs from enemies. This effect cannot be resisted by targets whose ATK is lower than this Champion’s. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. These debuffs cannot be resisted by targets whose ATK is lower than this Champion’s.

name: Metamorph [P]
description:
Transforms this Champion into their Alternate Form whenever this Champion is revived by a skill, effect, or <color=#1ee600>[Revive On Death]</color> buff. 

Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Engine of Murder [P]
description:
Whenever an enemy has their Turn Meter filled, this Champion inflicts pure damage on that enemy equal to 3% of their MAX HP for every 10% Turn Meter filled. Will inflict 6% of their MAX HP as pure damage instead, if the enemy is under a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff. This damage cannot be critical and will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Fervor]</color> buffs, <color=#1ee600>[Bone Armor]</color> stacks, and any damage modifying skills or effects. If the enemy is a Boss, the damage cannot exceed 50,000 HP per hit.

Whenever an enemy has their Turn Meter filled, also destroys their SPD by 3 for every 10% Turn Meter filled (stacks up to 100). Will destroy 6 SPD for every 10% Turn Meter filled instead, if the enemy is under a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff. This effect does not work against Bosses. 

Revives this Champion with 100% HP every 2 turns if at least one ally is alive. Once per Round, instantly revives this Champion with 100% HP if all allies are dead.

name: Fiery Rend
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff for 2 turns. 

Has a 50% chance of attacking with this skill whenever an enemy has a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff activated on them. Occurs once per turn.

name: Searing Brand
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Before attacking, places a <color=#1ee600>[Deathbrand]</color> debuff on the target for 2 turns.

Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs, as well as 25% of the target’s DEF. 

Activates this Champion’s <color=#1ee600>Pyrenei Power</color> skill if the target is killed. If the target survives, fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 50% instead.

name: Pyrenei Power
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ACC]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. 

Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 20% for each <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff placed on enemies, and fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 10% for each <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff resisted by enemies.

name: Underflame's Protection [P]
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Activates a <color=#1ee600>[Delay]</color> effect on this Champion whenever they receive a fatal hit.

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Heals this Champion by 20% of their MAX HP whenever a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff is activated on an enemy. 

Whenever a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff on an enemy expires or is removed, places a <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff on that enemy for 1 turn.

name: Spear of Serenity
description:
Attacks 1 enemy with 1 random ally from the Argonites Faction. The ally joining the attack will use their default skill. 

Heals all allies by 10% of this Champion’s MAX HP.

name: Gift of Thalass
description: Removes all debuffs from all allies and places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Debuffs]</color> buff and a <color=#1ee600>[Fervor]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Glorious Revival
description:
Revives all dead allies with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter. 

Places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase SPD]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Shield of the Argolades [P]
description:
Whenever an ally receives a debuff, places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on that ally equal to 20% of their MAX HP for 1 turn. 

Fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 15% at the end of this Champion’s turn.

name: Fulminant Rupture
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff and an <color=#1ee600>[Enfeeble]</color> debuff on the target for 1 turn. Also has a 25% chance that these debuffs cannot be resisted. 

If each enemy has a number of buffs that is equal to or less than this Champion’s, attacks all enemies instead. This attack is always critical. Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff and an <color=#1ee600>[Enfeeble]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. Also has a 25% chance that these debuffs cannot be resisted.

name: Eye of the Storm
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, places a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff for 2 turns and 1 <color=#1ee600>[Stormcall]</color> stack on all allies. This attack is always critical if the number of buffs on the target is equal to or less than this Champion's. 

Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> buff and 50% of the target's DEF if the number of buffs on the target is equal to or less than this Champion's. 

If this attack kills the target, decreases the Turn Meters of all other enemies by an amount equal to the Turn Meter that the target had.

name: Sky-Father's Boon
description:
Places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. RATE]</color> buff, a <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buff, and a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on a target ally for 2 turns. 

Fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 25%.

name: Boltmaster [P]
description:
Whenever an ally under a <color=#1ee600>[Stormcall]</color> stack placed by this Champion lands a critical hit, this Champion deals additional pure damage to the target. If the target is not a Boss or a minion, the pure damage dealt is equal to 2% of the target's MAX HP for each buff on this Champion (stacks up to 10%). If the target is a Boss or a minion, the pure damage dealt is equal to 3% of the target's MAX HP. This damage cannot be critical. Occurs once per skill and once per target. Does not count as an extra hit. This pure damage ignores <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buffs.

If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Stab
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has an extra 20% chance of inflicting a critical hit. Damage inflicted is proportional to DEF.

name: Triumphant Blow
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted or blocked if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff.

name: Gorgoa's Bane
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Will ignore 50% of the target’s DEF if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff. The damage inflicted by this skill increases by 10% for every turn remaining on any debuffs on this Champion and the target (stacks up to 200%). 

If the damage inflicted by this skill is less than 50% of the target’s MAX HP, steals all buffs from the target and places a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff on them for 2 turns. These effects cannot be resisted if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff.

name: Victor's Bounty
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff and a <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> is equal to 30% of this Champion’s MAX HP. 

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Taunt]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Decreases the damage all allies receive by 20% while this Champion is not under a <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Master of Games [P]
description:
This Champion is immune to <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Petrification]</color> debuffs. 

Whenever an enemy attacks this Champion, has a 100% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff on that enemy for 2 turns. The chance decreases to 50% if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff. Occurs once per enemy skill. 

Whenever an enemy attacks this Champion, also has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Petrification]</color> debuff on that enemy for 1 turn. The chance decreases to 25% if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff. Occurs once per enemy skill.

name: Hypnotic Bladework
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Attacks 1 enemy. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff on the target for 1 turn. 

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Instantly activates this skill against the enemy with the highest Turn Meter whenever an enemy's Turn Meter is increased by a skill. Occurs once per turn.

name: Perfection In Motion
description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. 

Each hit steals all buffs from all enemies. 

Then applies a <color=#1ee600>[Buff Spread]</color> effect, taking all buffs from this Champion and placing them on all allies.

name: Sneer of Disdain
description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. 

Each hit increases the cooldown of 1 of each enemy’s skills to the maximum. Also decreases the Turn Meters of all enemies by 30%. 

Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Metamorph
description:
Transforms this Champion into their Alternate Form. 

Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Is That... It? [P]
description:
This Champion receives no damage when attacked by enemies, including Bosses and their minions, out of their active turn. 

All allies except this Champion deal 3% more damage for each enemy skill that has had its cooldown increased by this Champion (stacks up to 25%). If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Strike On My Mark
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Fervor]</color> buff for 2 turns on a random ally except this Champion. If the randomly selected ally is already under a <color=#1ee600>[Fervor]</color> buff, places it on another randomly selected ally.

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Allies under a <color=#1ee600>[Fervor]</color> buff have a 50% chance of joining the attacks of other allies under a <color=#1ee600>[Fervor]</color> buff. This Champion will not join in any attacks. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Nexus Of Silk
description:
Places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase RES]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Also equalizes the HP levels of all allies. The HP levels of all allies will be brought up to the level of the ally with the highest HP.

name: The Webs Whisper
description:
Revives an ally with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter. 

Then places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 2 turns. Also places an <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. These buffs will be placed even if no allies were revived.

name: Theridine Visions [P]
description:
For every 8 buffs the enemy team receives, increases the Turn Meters of all allies by 20%. 

For every 16 buffs this Champion and their allies receive, heals all allies for 20% of their MAX HP.

name: Hammer Of Stone
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 80% chance of decreasing the target’s Turn Meter by 15%.

name: Good Shepherd
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Places a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff and a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is proportional to this Champion’s DEF. These buffs are protected if there are any dead allies when this skill is used. 

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Instantly activates this skill whenever an ally is killed. Instantly activating this skill will not put it on cooldown and will work even when this skill is on cooldown. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Smash And Stomp
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 2 turns. Also has a 75% chance of fully decreasing the target’s Turn Meter. 

If the <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff was successfully placed on the initial target, then attacks all enemies except the initial target. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. Also has a 75% chance of decreasing all enemies’ Turn Meters by 25%.

name: Vengeful Quest [P]
description:
Increases this Champion’s DEF by 3% (stacks up to 30%) and MAX HP by 5% (stacks up to 50%) for each <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff successfully landed by this Champion. 

Allies are immune to <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuffs while under a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff placed by this Champion’s <color=#1ee600>Good Shepherd</color> skill.

name: Strength Of Lakon
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Destroys 10% of the target’s MAX HP. Destroys 20% of the target’s MAX HP instead if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff (stacks up to 50%). 

Increases this Champion’s Turn Meter by 20%. Increases this Champion’s Turn Meter by 40% instead if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff.

name: By The Horns
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Will ignore 50% of the target’s DEF and any <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> buffs if this Champion’s MAX HP is greater than the target’s. 

If the target is killed, instantly activates the <color=#1ee600>Hard-earned Confidence</color> skill. If the target survives, heals all allies by an amount equal to the difference between the target's current HP and MAX HP.

name: Hard-earned Confidence
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Has a 80% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. Will ignore 50% RES against targets whose MAX HP is lower than this Champion’s. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Is That All You've Got? [P]
description: Enemies under <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuffs deal 50% less damage. Allies deal 20% more damage against enemies under <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuffs. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Envenomed Sickles
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Each hit has a 15% chance of increasing the duration of all enemy debuffs by 1 turn. If the 2nd hit does not increase the duration of all enemy debuffs, instantly activates all <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuffs on the target instead.

name: They Will Regret...
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Before attacking, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ACC]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. 

The first hit has a 75% chance of placing a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Poison Sensitivity]</color> debuff and two 5% <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuffs for 2 turns. 

The second hit applies a <color=#1ee600>[Debuff Spread]</color> effect, taking all <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuffs and the <color=#1ee600>[Poison Sensitivity]</color> debuff from the target and placing them on all other enemies.

name: Toxic Vitriol
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. Increases this Champion’s Turn Meter by 20% for each <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff placed. 

Instantly activates all <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuffs on all enemies.

name: Imbibed Immunity [P]
description:
This Champion is immune to <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuffs. 

Increases this Champion’s damage dealt by 5% (stacks up to 50%) and Ignore DEF effect by 3% (stacks up to 30%) for each active debuff on the enemy team. 

Whenever this Champion is attacked by an enemy under a debuff placed by this Champion, counterattacks using their default skill.

name: Fierce Friend
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Places one 15% <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff on this Champion and the ally with the lowest HP, excluding this Champion, for 1 turn.

name: Thieving Axeman
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

The first hit has a 75% chance of stealing all buffs from the target. The second hit transfers all debuffs from this Champion to the target. The third hit applies a <color=#1ee600>[Debuff Spread]</color> effect, taking all debuffs from the target and placing them on all other enemies.

name: Bucklan's Strength
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. Has 75% chance to place a <color=#1ee600>[Pain Link]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. The <color=#1ee600>[Pain Link]</color> debuff reflects 45% of the inflicted damage. 

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion and the ally with the highest C. DMG for 2 turns.

name: Disciple of Padraig [P]
description:
Heals all allies by 40% of any damage dealt to this Champion. 

At the end of this Champion’s turn, places a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn.

name: Eyes Of Granite
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 25% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

Steals 10% of the target’s Turn Meter.

name: Fangs Of Quartz
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Hex]</color> debuff and a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns.

name: Heart Of Flint
description:
Decreases the duration of all ally debuffs by 1 turn. 

Heals all allies by 15% of their MAX HP. 

Fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 20%.

name: Heir Of The Gorgoa [P]
description: Allies deal 10% more damage to enemies under debuffs placed by this Champion. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Each hit ignores 15% of the target's DEF. Ignores 30% of the target’s DEF instead if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> buff. 

Will attack all remaining enemies with any surplus damage if the initial target is killed.

name: Breaker Of Metals
description:

Each hit ignores 25% of the target’s DEF. Ignores 50% of the target’s DEF instead if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> buff. Will also deal double damage if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff. 

Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 50% and places a <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> buff equal to 200% of this Champion's ATK on this Champion for 1 turn.

name: In Magma Clad
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Each hit ignores 35% of the target's DEF. Will also deal double damage and ignore <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> buff. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> buff equal to 300% of this Champion's ATK on all allies for 2 turns and grants this Champion an Extra Turn if this attack kills the target.

name: Metamorph
description:
Transforms this Champion into their Alternate Form. 

Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Furnace-Shell [P]
description:
At the start of each Round and whenever this Champion is revived, places a <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> buff equal to 300% of this Champion's ATK on this Champion for 1 turn. 

This Champion receives 30% less damage from enemies when under a <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> buff. Heals this Champion by 50% of their MAX HP whenever a <color=#1ee600>[Magma Shield]</color> buff on them expires or is removed by damage.

name: Wavethrust
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times.

description:
Removes any <color=#1ee600>[Block Debuffs]</color> buffs from enemies and replaces them with a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff, lasting for 3 turns.

Also removes any buffs positively affecting stats, and replaces them with their mirrored debuff equivalent, such as <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> being replaced with <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color>. Buffs such as <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> will be replaced with <color=#1ee600>[Heal Reduction]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuffs respectively. All mirrored debuffs last for 3 turns. The buff removal is not affected by RES, but placing their debuff equivalent can be affected by RES.

Then, places a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff on all enemies except Mythical Champions for 1 turn. This debuff cannot be blocked or resisted by any means. Also, forces all Mythical Champions to change Form. 

Finally, fills <color=#ffe87d>Amius</color>’ Turn Meter by 10% for each buff converted into a debuff by this skill.

Grants an Extra Turn if a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff was placed by this skill.

description:

Increases the damage dealt to all other enemies by 1% for each 1% HP lost by the initial target (stacks up to 50%). 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff on all enemies, except the initial target, for 1 turn. Also decreases the Turn Meters of all enemies, except the initial target, by 50% if the <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff was resisted or blocked.

Finally, places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease C. RATE]</color> debuff, a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease C. DMG]</color> debuff, and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns.

All mirrored debuffs will last for 2 turns.

If the damage dealt by this skill is equal to or greater than 20% of the target's MAX HP, repeats the attack.

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Decreases the chance of a <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff activating on the <color=#ffe87d>Chimera</color> by 25%.

Removes any <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuffs from the <color=#ffe87d>Chimera</color> after activation (including protected debuffs).

<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

When receiving any debuffs, instantly transfers them from the <color=#ffe87d>Chimera</color> to the producer.

[Will not transfer debuffs that cannot be removed].

name: Shroud of the Shogun [P]
description:
Activates the <color=#1ee600>Shade</color> counter at the start of the battle. 

Whenever an enemy lands a weak hit on <color=#ffe87d>Akumori</color>, increases the <color=#1ee600>Shade</color> counter by 2 on Stage 3, 4 on Stage 12, and 6 on Stage 21. 

Whenever <color=#ffe87d>Akumori</color> lands a critical hit, increases the <color=#1ee600>Shade</color> counter by 5. 

Whenever an <color=#1ee600>[Enfeeble]</color> debuff is removed or transferred from an enemy, or when its duration is fully decreased by an enemy Champion, increases the <color=#1ee600>Shade</color> counter by 2. 

Increases <color=#ffe87d>Akumori</color>'s C. RATE by 1% and C. DMG by 2% for each <color=#1ee600>Shade</color> counter stack. 

<color=#ffe87d>Akumori</color> is immune to Turn Meter reduction effects and <color=#1ee600>[Enfeeble]</color> debuffs.

Whenever the <color=#1ee600>Shade</color> counter reaches 20, <color=#ffe87d>Akumori</color> will not receive damage from <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuffs. Whenever the <color=#1ee600>Shade</color> counter reaches 30, <color=#ffe87d>Akumori</color> will also not receive damage from <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuffs and <color=#1ee600>[Smite]</color> debuffs. Whenever the <color=#1ee600>Shade</color> counter reaches 40, <color=#ffe87d>Akumori</color> will also not receive damage from skills or Masteries that scale based on <color=#ffe87d>Akumori</color>'s MAX HP.

If the <color=#1ee600>Shade</color> counter reaches 50, all of <color=#ffe87d>Akumori</color>'s attacks will ignore 100% of the target's DEF. Also whenever <color=#ffe87d>Akumori</color> kills an enemy, attacks all remaining enemies.

Any subsequent hits inflicted by a skill will remove 0 stacks

Level 4 Awakening:

Any subsequent hits inflicted by a skill will remove 0 stacks

Level 3 Awakening:

Any subsequent hits inflicted by a skill will remove 0 stacks

Level 2 Awakening:
1st hit inflicted by a skill will remove 2 stacks
2nd hit inflicted by a skill will remove 1 stack
Any subsequent hits inflicted by a skill will remove 0 stacks

Level 1 Awakening:
1st hit inflicted by a skill will remove 1 stack
Any subsequent hits inflicted by a skill will remove 0 stacks

The second hit does the same, but the duration of the <color=#1ee600>[Ironbrand]</color> debuffs placed depends on each enemy's ATK instead.

<color=#1ee600>[Growth Effect]</color>

Every time this skill is used, the Iron Twins' ATK and DEF will be increased by 4%, plus an additional 1% for every enemy whose Affinity does not match the Iron Twins'.

The Iron Twins will only use this skill when their HP is below 40%.

name: Dreamless Sleep [P]

Activates the <color=#1ee600>Slumber</color> counter whenever a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff is placed on <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color>.

The <color=#1ee600>Slumber</color> counter disappears whenever a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff expires on <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> or is removed from him. <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuffs are not removed from <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> when he is attacked.

Decreases <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color>'s <color=#1ee600>Slumber</color> counter by 1 whenever <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> receives damage (except damage from debuffs).

Whenever the <color=#1ee600>Slumber</color> counter reaches 0, removes any <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuffs from <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> and fills his Turn Meter by 50%.

Whenever a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff expires or is removed from <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color>, he becomes immune to <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuffs for 1 turn.

The duration of the <color=#1ee600>Slumber</color> counter is 12 on Stage 7, 10 on Stage 16, and 8 on Stage 25.

Attacks all enemies 2 times. Each hit places or extends an <color=#1ee600>[Ironbrand]</color> debuff. 

The first hit places an <color=#1ee600>[Ironbrand]</color> debuff whose duration depends on each enemy’s DEF. The enemy with the highest DEF will receive 5 turns of <color=#1ee600>[Ironbrand]</color>. The enemy with the next highest DEF will receive 4 turns of <color=#1ee600>[Ironbrand]</color>, while the enemy with the next highest DEF will receive 3 turns of <color=#1ee600>[Ironbrand]</color>, and so on. If an enemy already has an <color=#1ee600>[Ironbrand]</color> debuff, the duration of their current <color=#1ee600>[Ironbrand]</color> debuff will be extended by this number of turns. 

The second hit does the same, but the duration of the <color=#1ee600>[Ironbrand]</color> debuffs placed depends on each enemy’s ATK instead. 

After the first two hits, attacks all enemies again. The damage inflicted to each enemy increases according to the number of turns remaining on each enemy’s <color=#1ee600>[Ironbrand]</color> debuffs. This hit will ignore 30% of each target's DEF.

<color=#1ee600>[Growth Effect]</color>

Every time this skill is used, the Iron Twins’ ATK and DEF will be increased by 4%, plus an additional 1% for every enemy whose Affinity does not match the Iron Twins’.

The Iron Twins will only use this skill when their HP is below 40%.

name: Retaliatory Launch [P]
description:
Whenever the Iron Twins’ HP drops below 80%, 60%, and 40%, removes all debuffs from the Iron Twins, then instantly attacks all enemies.

Fills the Iron Twins’ Turn Meter by 10% whenever an enemy receives a buff. Will not fill their Turn Meter if the Iron Twins are under <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuffs.

The Iron Twins receive 50% less damage from each subsequent hit from multi-hit skills. The damage reduction increases with every additional hit. 

The Iron Twins are immune to Turn Meter reduction effects.

description:
<color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> is immune to receiving all debuffs except <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color>. Also immune to HP exchange effects, HP balancing effects, cooldown increasing effects, Turn Meter reduction effects, and debuff duration increasing effects.

When under a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff, <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> is only immune to receiving <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Block Passive Skills]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Berserk]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Petrification]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Nullify]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Enfeeble]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Ensnare]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Fatigue]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Hunter's Gaze]</color> debuffs, as well as HP exchange effects, HP balancing effects, and cooldown increasing effects. 

Decreases incoming damage from enemy skills by 25% on Stages 1-5, by 50% on Stages 6-15, and by 75% on Stages 16-25. 

This innate damage reduction is decreased by 15% for each debuff that <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> is currently under.

description:

Whenever an enemy decreases <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color>’s Turn Meter, destroys the MAX HP of that enemy by the same percentage. 

Whenever <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> is under a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff and an enemy Champion is healed, restores a portion of that Champion's destroyed MAX HP. The amount restored is equal to the value of the heal.

description:

The <color=#1ee600>Slumber</color> counter disappears whenever a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff expires on <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> or is removed from him. <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuffs are not removed from <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> when he is attacked.

Decreases <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color>'s <color=#1ee600>Slumber</color> counter by 1 whenever <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> receives damage (except damage from debuffs).

Whenever the <color=#1ee600>Slumber</color> counter reaches 0, removes any <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuffs from <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color> and fills his Turn Meter by 50%.

Whenever a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff expires or is removed from <color=#ffe87d>Al-Naemeh</color>, he becomes immune to <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuffs for 1 turn.

The duration of the <color=#1ee600>Slumber</color> counter is 16 on Stages 1-5, 14 on Stages 6-10, 12 on Stages 11-15, 10 on Stages 16-20, and 8 on Stages 21-25.

The damage inflicted by this skill and the amount of DEF ignored against each target increases by 5% per each buff and debuff removed.

name: Thorn Prison
description:
Attacks all enemies under an <color=#1ee600>[Entangle]</color> debuff. Decreases each target's Turn Meter by 30%.

If there are no enemies under an <color=#1ee600>[Entangle]</color> debuff, attacks the enemy with the highest SPD. Places a protected <color=#1ee600>[Entangle]</color> debuff. This debuff cannot be <color=#1ee600>Evaded</color>, redirected to another target, or resisted. This debuff will also ignore <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color>.

name: Sublimate Life
description: Places a protected <color=#1ee600>[Entangle]</color> debuff on the enemy with the highest SPD. Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Siphon]</color> debuff on the enemy with the highest SPD for 3 turns.These debuffs cannot be <color=#1ee600>Evaded</color>, redirected to another target, resisted, or blocked. These debuffs will also ignore <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Taunt]</color> buffs.

name: Parasitic Growth [P]
description:
Whenever a <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff, placed by <color=#ffe87d>Leshun the Entangled One</color>, is activated, fills the Turn Meters of <color=#ffe87d>Leshun</color> and its allies by 10%, and also decreases the duration of all debuffs on <color=#ffe87d>Leshun</color> and its allies by 1 turn.

At the start of <color=#ffe87d>Leshun's</color> turn, deals damage to all enemies under an <color=#1ee600>[Entangle]</color> debuff. The damage dealt is equal to 20% of each target's MAX HP. Also destroys each target's MAX HP by 20% of the damage dealt.

If an enemy under an <color=#1ee600>[Entangle]</color> debuff is killed by damage from this skill, places another protected <color=#1ee600>[Entangle]</color> debuff on the enemy with the next highest SPD. Also places a <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff on all other enemies without an <color=#1ee600>[Entangle]</color> debuff for 1 turn.

name: Elder Tree [P]
description:
Decreases all incoming damage by 60% if <color=#ffe87d>Leshun the Entangled One</color> is not under a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff. Also has a 30% chance to change an incoming critical hit into a weak hit if <color=#ffe87d>Leshun</color> is not under a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff.

Turn Meter fill effects are 30% more effective on enemies under an <color=#1ee600>[Entangle]</color> debuff, if <color=#ffe87d>Leshun</color> is under a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff.

description:
Attacks 1 enemy. The damage inflicted is proportional to the target’s MAX HP. 

Fully depletes the target’s Turn Meter. Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn. These effects cannot be resisted.

description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. 

Places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff and a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff on each enemy for 2 turns.

name: Timeless Fury
description:
Attacks all enemies 4 times. Before attacking, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff on the <color=#ffe87d>Tainted Demon Lord</color> for 2 turns. 

Each hit has a 50% chance of decreasing the duration of all enemy buffs by 1 turn. Each hit also has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Master Seal]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn.

name: Titanic Endurance [P]
description:
The damage taken from skills that scale based on the <color=#ffe87d>Tainted Demon Lord</color>’s MAX HP, as well as damage from the Warmaster Mastery, Giant Slayer Mastery, <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuffs, and passive Reflect Damage skills or effects cannot exceed 100,000 HP.  

The damage taken by <color=#1ee600>[Smite]</color> debuffs cannot exceed 250,000 HP.  

The damage taken from one tick of a 2.5% <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuff cannot exceed 25,000 HP. The damage taken from one tick of a 5% <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuff cannot exceed 50,000 HP.

The <color=#ffe87d>Tainted Demon Lord</color> is immune to MAX HP destruction effects.

name: World-Killer [P]
description:
Starting from <color=#1ee600>the 1st turn</color>, the damage inflicted by all skills increases each turn. Damages increases by the same percentage each Turn, and accumulates over multiple turns. Starting from <color=#1ee600>the 20th turn</color>, damage is increased by a greater amount. 

Also starting from <color=#1ee600>the 1st turn</color>, the <color=#ffe87d>Tainted Demon Lord</color>'s ATK, DEF, SPD, RES, and ACC will increase each turn. Starting from <color=#1ee600>the 20th turn</color>, the <color=#ffe87d>Tainted Demon Lord</color>'s DEF, SPD, RES, and ACC will increase by a greater amount. 

Starting from <color=#1ee600>the 20th Turn</color>, all attacks will ignore any <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs on all enemies, and will place a <color=#1ee600>[Block Revive]</color> debuff if a target is killed. 

Finally, starting from <color=#1ee600>the 30th Turn</color>, decreases the value of any <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs on all enemies by 100% at the start of the <color=#ffe87d>Tainted Demon Lord</color>’s turn.

description: If this Champion has 2 or fewer buffs at the start of the turn, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn.

name: Dual Debility
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 25% chance of increasing the duration of a random debuff by 1 turn.

description: Inflicts 10% more damage against targets whose RES is lower than this Champion’s ACC.

name: Censorious Bludgeon
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 40% chance of placing a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease C. DMG]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Mind Prison

name: Pointed Justice
description:
Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of decreasing the duration of all enemy buffs by 2 turns. 

Increases the duration of all <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buffs on allies by 1 turn.

name: Heartstrong [P]
description:
At the start of each turn, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff for 2 turns on the ally with the lowest MAX HP. Will not be placed on this Champion.

Also places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff and a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Bloodshed Rites
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns if this attack is critical.

name: Maniacal Chopping
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 20% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn.

name: Leave Them Gutted
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 30% chance of increasing the cooldowns of all of each target’s skills by 2 turns.

name: Spymaster's Blade
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 40% chance of decreasing the duration of 2 random buffs on the target by 1 turn.

name: Directed Sabotage
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Cloak and Dagger
description: Places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Cloak and Dagger
description: Places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. Also has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn on 2 random enemies.

name: Dual Scalpel
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times.

name: Restraints
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 50% chance of placing a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

description: Places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Stimulant Elixir
description: Places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. Also places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Increase SPD]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Twisted Spike
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn equal to 10% of their MAX HP.

name: Swordbreak Cage
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of placing a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Bound to Serve
description: Places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Bound to Serve
description: Places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 2 turns. Also places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn.

name: Plunging Beak
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 50% chance of increasing the cooldown of one of the target’s Skills by 2 turns at random.

name: Befuddle
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Places a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 2 Turns. Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Block Debuffs]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs.

name: Gatewatch Stance
description: Places a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on this Champion for 3 turns and a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff for 2 turns.

name: Laughing Gull [P]
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Increases this Champion’s DEF by 10% each time they counterattack. DEF resets every time this Champion gets a turn.

When attacking, converts this Champion’s RES into additional ACC.

<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

At the end of this Champion’s turn, places a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn on all enemies under <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buffs.

name: Herd Mentality
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Any ally Sheep will join this attack.

Has a 50% chance of removing the <color=#1ee600>[Sheep]</color> debuff from this Champion after attacking.

description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 50% chance of stealing 1 random buff from the target.

name: Rainbow of Woe
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ACC]</color> debuff and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease RES]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Irresistible Wealth
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn. Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Joyful Song [P]
description:
At the start of this Champion's turn, transfers 1 random buff from a random enemy to a random ally. 

This Champion’s ACC is increased by 5 for each buff on each ally.

name: Dark Shroud
description:
Heals all allies by 20% of this Champion’s MAX HP.

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Debuffs]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns, then places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on all allies equal to 30% of this Champion's MAX HP for 2 turns.

name: Self Sacrifice
description: Revives all dead allies and heals them for 35% of their MAX HP. Places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 1 turn.

name: Brush Choppers
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 15% chance of placing an extra hit.

name: Crown Breaker
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs. Places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn if this attack kills an enemy.

name: Ancient Rage
description: Places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff on this Champion for 3 turns, then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Assassin of Kings [P]
description: Whenever this Champion kills an enemy, decreases the cooldown of the <color=#1ee600>Crown Breaker</color> skill by 1 turn.

name: Self Sacrifice
description:
Revives all dead allies with 30% Turn Meter and heals them for 50% of their MAX HP. 

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 1 turn.

name: Lunar Lance
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 60% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Moonlight Bonds
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff for 2 turns. Also fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 30%.

name: Blood Moon
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ACC]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Silver Fear [P]
description: When attacked, has a 35% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Hex]</color> debuff on the attacker for 1 turn after each hit.

name: Magnificent Scepter
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 30% chance of removing 1 random debuff from a random ally. Will not remove a debuff from this Champion.

name: Eternal Return
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Places a <color=#1ee600>[Revive On Death]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Lordly Might
description: Places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff and a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff equal to 20% of this Champion’s MAX HP on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Great Pillar [P]
description: Increases the value of all <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs placed on all allies by 15% when the buffs are placed.

name: Pressing Advance
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 25% chance of filling a random ally’s Turn Meter by 5%.

name: Rain of Gore
description: Attacks all enemies. Places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Bestial Communion
description: Heals a target ally by 25% of their MAX HP.

name: Bestial Communion
description: Heals a target ally by 25% of their MAX HP and places a <color=#1ee600>[Revive on Death]</color> buff on them for 2 turns.

name: Chuckling Sickles
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Grants an Extra Turn if this attack kills an enemy.

name: Jester's Remedy
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff on each enemy for 1 turn. Also has a 75% chance of placing 2 <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuffs on each enemy that detonate after 2 turns.

name: Explosive Wit
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. The first hit instantly detonates all <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuffs on the target. The second hit will ignore all <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buffs on the target.

name: Mad Bomber [P]
description:
When attacked, has a 30% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuff on the attacker that detonates after 2 turns. Occurs once per hit. The damage dealt by the <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuffs is based on this Champion's ATK.

Instantly detonates all <color=#1ee600>[Bomb]</color> debuffs on all enemies whenever this Champion is killed.

name: Staff of Liferip
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Heals this Champion by 5% of their MAX HP. Heals this Champion by 10% of their MAX HP instead if they have 50% HP or less.

name: Gaze Upon Me
description: Attacks all enemies. Places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 2 turns. Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff and a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Animus Infusion
description:
Heals a target ally by 20% of this Champion's MAX HP, then balances the HP of all allies. The HP levels of all allies will be brought up to the level of the ally with the highest HP. 

After balancing HP, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff on the initial target for 2 turns.

name: Transmute Pain [P]
description: Decreases the cooldown of the <color=#1ee600>Animus Infusion</color> skill by 1 turn for every 10% of HP this Champion loses.

name: Heckler of Legends
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 30% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn. The chance increases to 55% against <color=#F3BC02>Legendary</color> Champions.

name: Rats Off To Ya
description: Attacks all enemies. Has an 80% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff for 2 turns. Also has an 80% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color> debuff for 1 turn on each <color=#F3BC02>Legendary</color> Champion.

name: Get Comfy Everyone
description:
Places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff and a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff is proportional to this Champion’s DEF.

name: Too Awesome To Die [P]
description:
Whenever an ally is attacked, has a 100% chance of completely blocking 1 hit, decreasing the incoming damage to zero. This Champion will receive that damage instead. It will also redirect any debuffs from the hit to this Champion. The chance of blocking a hit and redirecting the debuffs decreases to 50% if the attacker is a Boss. Does not work if the attack on the ally was an AoE attack.

Whenever an enemy is healed, heals this Champion by 20% of that heal.

name: Didn't Need 'Em [P]
description: Increases this Champion’s HP, DEF, and SPD by 10% for each dead ally.

name: Heart Stealer
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Withering Scorn
description:

If the target is under an <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff, each hit has a 80% chance of removing it. This effect cannot be resisted.

name: Resurging Reversal
description:
Removes all debuffs from this Champion and heals them by 20% of their MAX HP. Heals this Champion by an additional 20% of their MAX HP for each debuff removed. 

Then, places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is proportional to this Champion's ATK. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> also increases by 5% for each debuff removed. 

Finally, attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs. Damage increases by 20% for each debuff removed by this skill.

name: Somnolence Spores
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Has a 100% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff for 1 turn and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff for 2 turns. If <color=#F3BC02>Oella</color> is on the same team, will place a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff instead of <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color>, and ignore 50% of each target's RES.

Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 15% whenever a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff placed by this skill expires.

If <color=#F3BC02>Oella</color> is on the same team, grants this Champion an Extra Turn.

name: Metabolism [P]
description: Has a 15% chance of decreasing the cooldown of one of this Champion’s skills by 1 turn every time they are healed by a <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff. The chance increases to 30% if <color=#F3BC02>Oella</color> is on the same team.
