description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 50% chance of placing a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuff for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted.

name: Putrescence
description:
Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of placing three 5% <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuffs for 2 turns. These debuffs cannot be resisted. 

Also increases the duration of all enemy debuffs by 1 turn. This effect cannot be resisted.

name: Arcane Havoc
description:
Attacks all enemies. Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ACC]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns before attacking. 

Also has a 75% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease RES]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted. Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 10% for each <color=#1ee600>[Decrease RES]</color> debuff placed by this skill.

name: Degrade [P]
description: Decreases each target’s ACC, C.RATE, and C.DMG by 3% for each <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuff on them. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Deep Cut
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 25% chance of placing a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Catch!
description: Attacks 4 times at random. Decreases the Turn Meter by 15% if this attack is critical.

name: Exemplar of Rage
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has an extra 10% chance of inflicting a critical hit. 

Each hit also has a 40% chance of increasing the duration of any <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuffs on the target by 1 turn.

name: Bloodshed Tempest
description:
Attacks 4 times at random. Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff on this Champion for 3 turns before attacking. 

Each hit has an extra 10% chance of inflicting a critical hit. Each hit also has a 75% chance of instantly activating any <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuffs on each target and decreasing the duration of those <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuffs by 1 turn. 

Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 30% if 3 or more <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuffs are activated during the attack.

name: Unreasoning Outburst
description:
Attacks all enemies. Has an extra 10% chance of inflicting a critical hit. Has a 75% chance of placing <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuffs for 2 turns. 

Also places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff on targets whose Turn Meter is higher than 50%.

name: Laugh At Danger [P]
description: Whenever this Champion receives a <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color>, or <color=#1ee600>[Petrification]</color> debuff, instantly removes it. Then, fully heals this Champion, and grants an Extra Turn.

name: Exemplar of Stoicism
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. If there are any enemies under a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff, also attacks them. 

Decreases the enemy’s ATK by 3% whenever this Champion hits an enemy with this skill (stacks up to 30%). 

Also increases this Champion’s ATK by 3% whenever they hit an enemy with this skill (stacks up to 30%).

name: Cold Company
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, has a 100% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff for 1 turn.

Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buffs, as well as 20% of the target's DEF on enemies under a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff.

name: Ever Faithful
description:
Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff, a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. RATE]</color> buff, a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff, and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ACC]</color> buff on this Champion for 3 turns, then grants an Extra Turn. 

The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is proportional to this Champion's ATK.

name: Frosty Glare [P]
description:
Has a 15% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff on attackers for 1 turn when hit while under a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff. 

Has a 35% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn whenever a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on this Champion is removed by damage.

description: Decreases the damage received from skills by all allies under <color=#1ee600>[Veil]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buffs by 5%.

Damage inflicted by this skill cannot be decreased by enemy Passive skills or Masteries, except by the Passive skills of Bosses. Damage inflicted by this skill cannot be increased by either this Champion's Masteries or ally Passive skills, except when attacking Bosses.

Resets the cooldown of the <color=#1ee600>[Crowd Favorite]</color> skill if this attack kills an enemy.

name: Crowd Favorite
description:
Attacks all enemies. Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff on this Champion for 3 turns before attacking. 

Resets the cooldown of the <color=#1ee600>[Strip Away]</color> skill if this attack kills an enemy.

name: Percussion [P]
description: Each of this Champion’s skills deals additional pure damage. The amount of pure damage dealt is equal to 10% of the target’s MAX HP for each buff on them. The additional pure damage dealt will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs.

name: Booncatcher
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 30% chance of stealing 1 random buff.

name: Revelation
description:

Also has a 75% chance of removing 1 random buff from all enemies.

name: Focused Force
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs. 

Resets the cooldown of this skill if this attack kills an enemy.

description: Increases this Champion’s ACC by 10 for each buff on each enemy.

description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn.

name: Bring It On!
description:

The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is proportional to DEF. This buff cannot be removed.

name: Touch of Slumber
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 80% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff for 1 turn. 

Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 15% if the <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff is placed.

name: Lost In The Woods
description:
Has a 75% chance of placing a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff and a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. 

Restores 100% of each ally's destroyed MAX HP, then heals all allies by 20% of this Champion's MAX HP.

name: Otherworld Infusion
description: Removes all debuffs from all allies, then places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Debuffs]</color> buff and a <color=#1ee600>[Revive on Death]</color> buff on them for 2 turns.

description: Has a 30% chance of completely blocking the incoming damage of the first hit of an attack on a random ally. Occurs once per turn.

name: Hopping Mad
description: Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit will fill this Champion’s Turn Meter by 5%.

name: Night of the Rabbit
description:
Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff for 2 turns. 

Heals this Champion by 10% of their MAX HP for each <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff placed by this skill.

name: Keep Up If You Can
description: Attacks all enemies. Places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase SPD]</color> buff and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ACC]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns before attacking.

name: Built For Speed [P]
description: Each <color=#1ee600>[Increase SPD]</color> buff placed by this Champion increases this Champion's SPD by 5 (Stacks up to 100).

name: Purifyre
description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. The first hit has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. 

Restores this Champion’s destroyed MAX HP by 10% for each <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff placed by this skill. Heals this Champion by 5% of their MAX HP for each <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff attempt blocked or resisted by the enemy team.

name: Burning Blood [P]
description:
Whenever a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff is activated, destroys this Champion’s MAX HP by 5%. Stacks up to 50%. 

Increases this Champion’s DMG, C. DMG, and DEF by 1% for each 1% of their destroyed MAX HP. Also increases this Champion’s SPD and RES by 2 for each 1% of their destroyed MAX HP.

name: Bath of Azoth
description:

Each hit also has a 20% chance of placing a 5% <color=#1ee600>[Poison]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Restorative Froth
description:
Places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff on all allies for 1 turn.

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff equal to 20% of this Champion's MAX HP on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Instincts [P]
description: Has a 30% chance of counterattacking when ally Lizardmen except this Champion are attacked.

name: Double Shot
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Has an extra 15% chance of inflicting a critical hit. Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 15% if this attack is critical.

name: Rain of Arrows
description: Attacks all enemies 2 times. Has a 10% chance to place a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff for 1 turn.

description: Attacks 1 enemy. Places a 7.5% <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff for 1 turn on the ally with the lowest HP.

name: Living Barricade
description:
Places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 2 turns. 

Also places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Defend The Wall!
description: Attacks all enemies. Places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 1 turn. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is proportional to this Champion’s DEF.

name: Healing Bombardment
description:
Attacks all enemies. Heals this Champion by 10% of the damage dealt. 

Increases the duration of all buffs on all allies by 1 turn.

name: Let None Pass!
description:
Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn. 

Also places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase RES]</color> buff and a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: This Wall Won't Fall! [P]
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Whenever this Champion is attacked, heals all allies except this Champion by 70% of the damage received. Only heals by 35% of the damage received from Boss attacks. This effect has no cooldown. 

<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Places an <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn before receiving a fatal hit.

name: Splinter Steel
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

The first hit has a 30% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn. The second hit has a 30% chance of placing a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Barrier Breach
description:
Attacks all enemies. Will ignore 20% of each target’s DEF. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted if <color=#F3BC02>Alsgor Crimsonhorn</color> is on the same team.

name: Towering Might
description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. 

Before attacking, places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. RATE]</color> buff and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. 

Grants an Extra Turn if this attack kills an enemy when <color=#F3BC02>Alsgor Crimsonhorn</color> is on the same team.

name: Nowhere To Hide [P]
description:
Inflicts 20% more damage against targets under <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs. 

Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs if <color=#F3BC02>Alsgor Crimsonhorn</color> is on the same team.

name: Thunderous Maul
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Heals this Champion by 20% of the damage dealt. 

Has a 40% chance of increasing the duration of 2 random debuffs on the target Champion by 1 turn.

name: Crack the Sky
description:
Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of removing 2 random buffs from all enemies. 

Has a 75% chance of removing all buffs from all enemies, even if this attack lands as a weak hit, if <color=#F3BC02>Jetni the Giant</color> is on the same team. 

Also places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Resounding Rally
description:
Fully heals a target ally. 

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Trammel
description:
When attacked, has a 50% chance of placing a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff on the attacker for 2 turns. 

The chance increases to 100% if <color=#F3BC02>Jetni the Giant</color> is on the same team.

description: Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 5% for each <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff placed by this Champion.

description: Attacks 1 enemy 4 times. Each hit heals the ally with the lowest HP by 2% of this Champion’s MAX HP.

name: Shaman's Gift
description:
Heals all allies by 10% of this Champion’s MAX HP.

name: Tusked Protection
description: Places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Reflect Damage]</color> buff and a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff equal to 20% of this Champion’s MAX HP on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Ogryn Restoration [P]
description: Restores destroyed MAX HP whenever this Champion heals themselves or an ally. The amount of HP restored is equal to 30% of the heal.

name: Lancer
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 30% chance of stealing 1 random buff from the target.

name: Excoriating Light
description:
Attacks all enemies.

Before attacking, has a 50% chance of removing any <color=#1ee600>[Block Debuffs]</color> buffs from all enemies. 

Also has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns after attacking.

name: Shield of Aravia
description:
Places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns equal to 20% of this Champion’s MAX HP. 

Also places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Inviolable Nobility [P]
description: Heals this Champion by 30% of their MAX HP whenever a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff placed by the <color=#1ee600>Shield of Aravia</color> skill on this Champion expires, is removed, or is broken by an enemy attack.

name: Gotcha!
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 25% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn. The chance increases to 50% if the target has any buffs.

name: Staff of Wonder
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore 50% of the target’s DEF. 

Will attack all remaining enemies with any surplus damage if the target is killed. This attack will also ignore 50% of the target’s DEF. This attack cannot be critical. 

If the initial target survives, places a <color=#1ee600>[Sheep]</color> debuff on them for 1 turn. This debuff cannot be blocked.

name: Now You See Us
description: Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, steals all buffs from all enemies and then places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff on them for 2 turns.

name: Unbeatable Wukong [P]
description: Revives this Champion with 100% HP and 100% Turn Meter 3 turns after they were killed.

name: Fae Bolt
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Instantly activates one random <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff on all allies with less than 85% HP.

name: Mistwood Healing
description:
Removes all debuffs from a target ally, then heals that ally by 50% of this Champion's MAX HP. This heal can be critical.

If the target ally is not fully healed, places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buff on them for 2 turns. If the ally is fully healed, fills their Turn Meter by 50% and heals all allies equal to 50% of the surplus heal.

name: Rhythmic Strength
description:
Places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff and a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Also decreases the cooldown of all ally skills, except this Champion's, by 1 turn.

name: Aegis of the Forest [P]
description: Places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff equal to 15% of this Champion’s MAX HP on the ally with the lowest HP for 2 turns at the start of this Champion's turn.

name: Transference Slash
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Each hit transfers a random debuff from this Champion to the target. Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 5% for each transferred debuff.

Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns if this attack kills an enemy. These buffs cannot be removed.

name: Swift Blow
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times.

name: Cut Down To Size
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Removes 2 random buffs from the target.

name: Purge
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Enemies killed by this skill cannot be revived.

name: Headshot
description: Attacks 1 enemy. If the target has less than 30% HP, this attack is always critical.

name: Dwarven Might
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

Each hit has an 80% chance of decreasing the target’s Turn Meter by 15%. If the target’s Turn Meter is not decreased, each hit has an 80% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff on the target for 1 turn instead.

name: Fury of the King
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff and a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. 

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Blessed Bash
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit decreases the target’s DEF by 3% (Stacks up to 30%). 

Each hit also heals this Champion by 30% of the damage dealt.

name: No Holding Back [P]
description: When counterattacking, deals 100% of damage instead of 75%.

name: Piercing Bolt
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 50% chance of placing a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Dread Scythe
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. This attack ignores <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs. 

Has a 60% chance of increasing the duration of all debuffs on the target by 1 turn. 

Also has an 80% chance of applying a <color=#1ee600>[Debuff Spread]</color> effect, taking 2 random debuffs from the target and placing them on all enemies under a <color=#1ee600>[Hex]</color> debuff.

name: Hex of Blades
description:
Attacks all enemies. This attack deals single-target damage to each target individually, rather than AoE damage.

Before attacking, has an 80% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Hex]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. Will ignore 20% of each enemy's RES for each dead ally. 

Damage of this skill increases by 10% for each debuff on each enemy.

name: Death's Bargain
description:
Target an ally.

If the ally is alive, kills them and unlocks a secret skill, <color=#1ee600>Malice Unleashed</color>. Also places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuff for 2 turns and <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff for 1 turn on all enemies. These debuffs cannot be resisted or blocked. Then, fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 75%. 

If the ally is dead, heals this Champion by 50% of the dead ally's MAX HP. If all allies are dead, also unlocks a secret skill, <color=#1ee600>Malice Unleashed</color>. Places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is equal to any surplus heal. If this Champion already has a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff, the value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is increased by any surplus heal. Then, fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 75%.

name: Phantom Bulwark [P]
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color> 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on this Champion each time an ally or enemy Champion dies. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff is equal to 50% of the dead Champion's MAX HP. This <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff cannot be removed, stolen, or transferred. 

If this Champion is already under a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff, the value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is increased by 50% of the dead Champion's MAX HP. Does not activate when a Boss or minion dies. 

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color> 

Whenever an enemy hits this Champion while they are under a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff, places a random debuff on the attacking enemy. <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Petrification]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuffs are placed for 1 turn. Any other debuffs are placed for 2 turns. Will ignore 20% of enemy RES for each dead ally. 

Cannot place Boss-exclusive debuffs, <color=#1ee600>[Sheep]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Smite]</color> debuffs.

name: Malice Unleashed
description:
Attacks 1 enemy.

Before attacking, steals all buffs from the target. This effect cannot be resisted. 

If the target has ATK equal to or higher than this Champion's ATK, this attack gains a bonus damage multiplier, equal to the target's ATK. Not applicable to Bosses. 

If the target's ATK is less than this Champion's ATK, this attack will ignore 50% of the target's DEF.

This attack will also ignore <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buffs. Places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Revive]</color> debuff if the target is killed.

name: Spearshower
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Has a 15% chance of placing a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease C. RATE]</color> debuff for 2 turns. 

If this Champion’s HP is full, the chance increases to 30%.

name: Rallying Banner
description:
Places a <color=#1ee600>[Taunt]</color> buff on a target ally for 2 turns. 

Also places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Reflect Damage]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Field Medic
description: Decreases the duration of 2 random debuffs on all allies by 1 turn. Then, heals all allies by 5% of their MAX HP.

name: Field Medic
description: Decreases the duration of 2 random debuffs on all allies by 1 turn. Then, heals all allies by 5% of their MAX HP. Heals by an additional 2.5% MAX HP for each debuff that has its duration decreased.

name: Bestial Leap
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 30% chance of stealing one random buff.

name: Terror Assault
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn if this attack kills an enemy. Also places an <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn if this attack kills an enemy.

name: Vitality Feast
description: Swaps HP with an enemy, then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Prey on the Weak [P]
description: Deals 30% more damage against targets whose current HP is lower than this Champion’s current HP.

name: Protective Cleave
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on this Champion equal to 10% of the damage dealt for 2 turns. Also heals this Champion by 10% of the damage dealt if their HP is less than 50%.

name: Paralyzing Stakes
description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. 

The first hit has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff for 2 turns. The second hit has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff for 1 turn if enemies are not under a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff.

name: Glimmering Gold
description:
Places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff on this Champion for 3 turns, and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ACC]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. 

Then, grants an Extra Turn.

name: Strike at the Heart [P]
description:
Ignores 10% of DEF when attacking Support, DEF, and HP Champions. 

[Does not work against Bosses]

name: Blade Mirage
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each critical hit fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 5%.

name: Dagger Storm
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Before attacking, places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. RATE]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns. 

The first hit has a 50% chance of placing a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff for 2 turns. The second hit has a 50% chance of placing a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Ruthless Assassin [P]
description:
Each hit from this Champion deals an extra 5% damage if the target is under <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuffs.

Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 45% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn. 

Has a 30% chance of counterattacking whenever an ally is hit. If the ally is from the High Elves Faction and not this Champion, the chance increases to 100%. Occurs once per hit.

name: Formation: Phalanx
description:
Attacks all enemies. Has a 75% chance of removing all <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs and 2 random buffs from all enemies. 

Then, places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is proportional to this Champion's DEF.

name: Defensive Measures
description:
Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 2 turns. Also places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

Heals any ally <color=#F3BC02>Arbiter</color>s by 100% of their MAX HP.

Instantly activates this skill whenever this Champion is revived. This will not set this skill on cooldown.

name: Crisis Response [P]
description:
Increases all allies' ACC by 20 for each ally under an <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff. 

When killed, resets the cooldown of the <color=#1ee600>Destiny's Call</color> skill for any ally <color=#F3BC02>Arbiter</color>s. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, this effect will only activate once.

All ally <color=#F3BC02>Arbiter</color>s receive 30% less damage.

name: Ultimate Purpose [P]
description:
Increases all allies' RES by 20 for each ally under an <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff. 

This Champion will also receive 20% of the damage of any ally <color=#F3BC02>Arbiter</color>s. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, this effect will only activate once. 

If any ally <color=#F3BC02>Arbiter</color> is about to get killed by a fatal hit, places an <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buff on her for 1 turn. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, this effect will only activate once.

name: Rimecleave
description:
Attacks 1 enemy.

Will ignore 15% of the target's DEF. If the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff, ignores 35% of the target's DEF instead.

If this attack kills an enemy, resets the cooldown of one of this Champion's random skills.

name: Icequake
description:
Attacks all enemies. Places an extra hit on enemies under <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color>, or <color=#1ee600>[Petrification]</color> debuffs. 

Each hit decreases each target’s MAX HP by 25% of the damage inflicted (stacks up to 50%). 

Each hit also decreases each target’s Turn Meter by 25%. This effect cannot be resisted if an enemy is under <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color>, or <color=#1ee600>[Petrification]</color> debuffs.

name: Disciple of Tormin
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Will ignore 50% of the target's DEF. If the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff, will ignore 100% of the target's DEF and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs instead. 

If the target is killed while under a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff, also places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Revive]</color> debuff on them, and places a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn.

The <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff cannot be blocked or resisted by enemies from the Gaellen Pact.

name: Metamorph
description: Transforms this Champion into their Base Form. Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Frosty Resolve [P]
description:
Counterattacks with the <color=#1ee600>Rimecleave</color> skill whenever an enemy increases the cooldown of any of this Champion's skills.

Whenever an ally is killed, has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. This chance increases to 100% and cannot be blocked or resisted by enemies from the Gaellen Pact.

name: Darken the Sky
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit has a 30% chance of removing 1 random buff from the target. 

Each hit also heals this Champion by 20% of the damage inflicted.

name: Deathwhirl
description:
Attacks all enemies. Places an extra hit on enemies under no buffs. The extra hit will ignore 20% of the target’s DEF. 

Each hit also heals all allies by 20% of the damage inflicted.

name: Face the Blackflail!
description:
Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase RES]</color> buff and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Reflect Damage]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Taunt]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Red Mist [P]
description: Counterattacks with the <color=#1ee600>Darken the Sky</color> skill when hit while under a <color=#1ee600>[Taunt]</color> buff placed by this Champion.

name: Harmonious Strike
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 15% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn.

name: Blades of Finality
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buffs. 

Each hit also heals this Champion by 20% of the damage inflicted.

name: Dragon Shuriken
description: Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. RATE]</color> buff and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Sanctified Killer [P]
description:
Increases this Champion’s C. DMG by 10% every time they kill an enemy (stacks up to 30%). These stacks will not reset upon death. 

If this Champion’s <color=#1ee600>Blades of Finality</color> skill kills an enemy, the next skill they use will ignore 30% of the target's DEF.

name: I Will Find You...
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Destroys the target’s SPD by 3 (stacks up to 30). 

Decreases the target’s Turn Meter by 5% per each alive ally, and by an additional 2.5% per each alive enemy.

name: Baleful Onslaught
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, steals all buffs from all enemies. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff and a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff for 2 turns on all enemies. If an enemy’s SPD is lower than this Champion’s SPD, these debuffs will be protected.

name: Somnolent Whisper
description:
Places a <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color> debuff for 1 turn and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff for 2 turns on all enemies. If an enemy’s SPD is lower than this Champion’s SPD, the <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff will be protected. 

Then decreases the Turn Meters of all enemies by 25%.

name: Metamorph
description: Transforms this Champion into their Base Form. Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: They Are Beneath Me [P]
description:
This Champion is immune to <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuffs.

When allies attack, their damage is increased by 25% of their target's current Turn Meter. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Twysted Bark
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 15% chance of placing a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Burst of Despair
description: Attacks all enemies. Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 5% for each <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff on each enemy.

name: Feasting Shadow
description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Feasting Shadow
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ACC]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

Has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Glacial Carve
description:
Attacks 1 enemy.

Places a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on a random ally and this Champion for 2 turns. If the randomly selected ally is already under a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff, places it on another randomly selected ally.

Heals this Champion and any allies under <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buffs. The value of the heal is proportional to this Champion's DEF.

name: Frozen Tendrils
description:
Places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Debuffs]</color> buff and a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

Places a 100% <color=#1ee600>[Ensnare]</color> debuff and a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. These debuffs cannot be resisted by enemies under a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff or a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff.

name: Iceblade Tempest
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, places 1 <color=#1ee600>[Intercept]</color> stack on all allies. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted.

name: Metamorph
description: Transforms this Champion into their Base Form. Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Cryomantic Revival [P]
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Allies under a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff receive 90% less damage. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

Whenever this Champion is attacked, places a <color=#1ee600>[HP Burn]</color> debuff on the attacker for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted.

Removes any <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuffs from each ally before the start of their turn.

<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Once per Round while in this Champion's Alternate Form, revives each ally, including this Champion, with 100% HP. Places a <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color> debuff on the revived ally for 1 turn. This debuff cannot be resisted or blocked.

name: Stoke Anguish
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Each hit decreases the target's DEF by 2% (stacks up to 20%). 

Each hit also steals 10% of the target's Turn Meter.

name: Agony Overwhelming
description:
Attacks all enemies. Removes all buffs from all enemies and places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff on them for 2 turns. 

Also steals 20% of the Turn Meter from each enemy under a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff.

name: Thief of Joy
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Steals 100% of the target’s Turn Meter. 

Also, puts the target's skills on cooldown.

name: Metamorph
description: Transforms this Champion into their Alternate Form. Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Dramatis Miserae [P]
description:
Whenever this Champion loses 30% HP or more in a single turn, deals damage to the attacker equal to 30% of this Champion’s MAX HP. Occurs once per turn. 

Also when this Champion loses 30% HP or more in a single turn, places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on them, equal to 30% of this Champion’s MAX HP, for 2 turns.

name: Radiant Blades
description:
Attacks all enemies. This attack deals single-target damage to each target individually, rather than AoE damage. 

Whenever this Champion counterattacks, increases the Ignore DEF effect of this skill by 5% (stacks up to 25%).

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Deals double damage when counterattacking.

name: Pierced By Light
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, steals 25% of each enemy’s Turn Meter. This effect cannot be resisted.

The damage inflicted by this skill increases by 35% against enemies whose RES is lower than this Champion’s. 

Then places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Seraphic Swoop
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buffs. Will also ignore 35% DEF against targets whose RES is lower than this Champion’s. 

If the target is killed and has lower RES than this Champion, places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Revive]</color> debuff on them. If the target isn’t killed and has lower RES than this Champion, grants an Extra Turn instead.

name: Metamorph
description: Transforms this Champion into their Base Form. Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Lumaya's Glory [P]
description:
Decreases the damage this Champion receives from enemies whose RES is lower than this Champion's by 15%. 

Places a protected <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn at the end of their turn.

name: Destroyer of All
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

If this attack kills an enemy, deals pure damage to all other enemies. If the other enemies are not Bosses or minions, the amount of pure damage dealt is equal to 30% of the initial target's MAX HP. If the other enemies are Bosses or minions, the pure damage dealt is equal to 10% of their MAX HP instead. This attack cannot be critical.

name: Icon of Havoc
description: Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, steals all buffs from all enemies. Targets whose ATK is lower than this Champion’s ATK cannot resist this effect. Also places a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuff on all enemies for 2 turns. Targets whose ATK is equal to or lower than this Champion’s ATK cannot resist this effect.

name: Ruthless Agent
description:
Places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Shatter]</color> buff and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. RATE]</color> buff on this Champion for 3 turns. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. Targets whose ATK is equal to or lower than this Champion’s ATK cannot resist this effect. 

Grants an Extra Turn.

description: Transforms this Champion into their Base Form. Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Vile Murderess [P]
description: Deals 15% more damage for each dead ally. Each critical hit boosts this Champion’s Turn Meter by 10% for each dead ally.

name: Guerrilla Tactics
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

The ally with the highest C. DMG will team up and join the attack. The ally joining the attack will use their default skill. 

The damage dealt by this Champion and the ally joining the attack will be increased by 10% for each debuff on the target (stacks up to 100%).

name: Draconic Retribution
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

Each hit will ignore 10% of the target’s DEF for each debuff on the target (stacks up to 50%). Each hit will also increase this Champion’s ATK by 10% (stacks up to 50%). 

Grants an Extra Turn if this attack kills an enemy.

name: Wrath of the Legion
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Before attacking, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

Places an extra hit on enemies under any debuffs.

name: Survival At All Costs [P]
description: Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 5% whenever an enemy or an ally receives a debuff.

name: Astral Ravage
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 5% for each critical hit. Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by additional 5% for each critical hit, if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff or a <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff. 

If this attack kills an enemy, grants an Extra Turn instead.

name: Deaththread Spin
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Will always use this skill instead of the default skill when counterattacking. This skill cannot be blocked by <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuffs. 

Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs. Additionally ignores <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buffs if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff or a <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff. 

Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 15% for each critical hit.

name: Gossamer Execution
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 4 times. 

Each hit will ignore 15% of the target’s DEF. Each hit will ignore 30% DEF instead if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff or a <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff. 

Fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 20% for each critical hit. 

Then places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Metamorph
description: Transforms this Champion into their Base Form. Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Great Web Mistress [P]
description:
This Champion is immune to <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color>, and <color=#1ee600>[Petrification]</color> debuffs while under a <color=#1ee600>[Veil]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff. 

This Champion also cannot receive critical hits while under a <color=#1ee600>[Veil]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff.

name: The Hand of Diamant
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Heals all allies by 5% of this Champion’s MAX HP. Heals by an additional 2% of this Champion’s MAX HP for each buff on this Champion.

name: Charitable Donation
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Increases the duration of all ally buffs by 1 turn. 

Fills the Turn Meter of all allies by 20%.

name: Protection Racket
description:
Places 3 <color=#1ee600>[Intercept]</color> stacks on a target ally. 

Also places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase RES]</color> buff and a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Kingpin [P]
description:
Has a 50% chance to convert a debuff into a buff before it is placed on an ally. Works with the following debuffs: 

- Converts a 25% and 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuffs into a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff
- Converts a 30% and 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuffs into a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff
- Converts a 15% and 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuffs into a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase SPD]</color> buff
- Converts a 15% and 25% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease C. RATE]</color> debuffs into a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. RATE]</color> buff
- Converts a 15% and 25% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease C. DMG]</color> debuffs into a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buff

name: Blade Axel
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted if the target's HP is lower than this Champion's.

name: Frenzied Execution
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> buffs. The damage inflicted by this skill increases by 50% if the target's HP is lower than this Champion's. 

Resets the cooldown of this skill if the target is killed.

name: Soul Separator
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase C.DMG]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Steals 50% of the target's Turn Meter. Steals 100% Turn Meter instead if the target's HP is lower than this Champion's. 

Destroys the target's MAX HP by 25% of the damage inflicted. Destroys the target's MAX HP by 50% of the damage inflicted if the target's MAX HP is lower than this Champion's.

name: Metamorph
description: Transforms this Champion into their Base Form. Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Rage Nexus [P]
description:
Will ignore 15% of a target’s DEF if the target's HP is lower than this Champion's. Will also ignore 15% of the target’s DEF if the target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff. 

Every third skill this Champion uses will attack all enemies instead. 

This Champion joins every third attacking skill used by allies. This Champion will use their default skill when joining in that skill.

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

name: To Death, Unsurrendered
description:
Teams up with all allies to attack a single enemy. The allies joining the attack will use their default skills. Before attacking, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff and a 7.5% <color=#1ee600>[Shatter]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Decreases the cooldowns of all allies’ active skills, except this Champion’s, by 1 turn if the target is killed.

name: Dark Whisperings [P]
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Allies inflict 20% more damage against enemies under <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuffs. 

<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Whenever an ally is killed, instantly activates the <color=#1ee600>Magicks of Ireth</color> skill. Will not put the skill on cooldown. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Satrap's Secrets
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 100% chance of stealing 1 random buff from the target. Also has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Dragonkin Knowledge
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease RES]</color> debuff, a <color=#1ee600>[Pain Link]</color> debuff, and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease SPD]</color> debuff for 2 turns. These debuffs are protected when placed on Bosses. 

Heals all allies by 5% of this Champion’s MAX HP for each debuff placed.

name: Ward of the Heritage
description:
Places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Debuffs]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Heals all allies by 15% of this Champion's MAX HP. Heals each ally by an additional 3% for each debuff on them. 
 
Removes any debuffs from allies negatively affecting stats, and replaces them with their mirrored buff equivalent, such as <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> being replaced with <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color>. Debuffs such as <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Heal Reduction]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> will be replaced with <color=#1ee600>[Block Debuffs]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buffs respectively. 

Does not convert <color=#1ee600>[Decrease C. RATE]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Decrease C. DMG]</color> debuffs into <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. RATE]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Increase C. DMG]</color> buffs respectively.

name: Resilient Caste [P]
description: Increases this Champion’s MAX HP by 10% whenever this Champion heals themselves using a skill (stacks up to 50%).

name: Ravenblade
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 40% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff for 2 turns. This effect cannot be resisted if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff. 

Whenever an ally counterattacks, teams up with allies to attack, or instantly activates a skill, also has a 40% chance to place a <color=#1ee600>[Block Active Skills]</color> debuff for 2 turns on the target enemy. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Student of War
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. This attack is always critical if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff. This attack also gains a damage boost equal to the percentage difference between this Champion's MAX HP and the value of any <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs on them.

Removes all debuffs from all allies if the target is killed. If the target survives, places a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn instead. This effect cannot be resisted if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff.

name: Androc's Confidant
description:
Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff, a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff, and a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase SPD]</color> buff on a single ally for 2 turns. Also fills that ally’s Turn Meter by 40%. 

Instantly activates this skill at the end of an ally’s turn if that ally has no buffs and their HP is lower than 100%. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: For Lord & Land [P]
description: Each time an enemy hits an ally, that ally’s next attack will deal 10% more damage for each hit they take (stacks up to 100%). The damage increase resets after that ally deals damage.

name: Skill 99005 name
description: Skill 8000628 description

name: Stigmata
description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 60% chance of placing a 100% <color=#1ee600>[Heal Reduction]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Falling from Grace
description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. Each hit has a 90% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

The <color=#1ee600>[Block Buffs]</color> debuff cannot be resisted if a target is under a <color=#1ee600>[Heal Reduction]</color> debuff.

name: Fiery Rage [P]
description: Has a 20% chance to unlock a secret skill, Peril, for 1 turn when attacked.

name: Peril
description: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs as well as DEF. Enemies killed by this skill cannot be revived.

name: Fiery Rage [P]
description: Has a 20% chance to unlock a secret skill, Peril, for 1 turn when attacked. Also has a 20% chance to fill this Champion's Turn Meter by 25%.

name: Hound-Tyrant
description:
Attacks all enemies. This attack deals single-target damage to each target individually, rather than AoE damage. Will also ignore all <color=#1ee600>[Reflect Damage]</color> buffs and effects, <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buffs and effects, and <color=#1ee600>[Pain Link]</color> debuffs. 

This attack also deals double damage when counterattacking if <color=#F3BC02>Packmaster Shy'ek</color> is on the team.

name: Festering Jaw
description:
Attacks all enemies. Places an extra hit on enemies under 2 or more debuffs. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff and a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Weaken]</color> debuff for 2 turns. These debuffs cannot be resisted if <color=#F3BC02>Packmaster Shy'ek</color> is on the team.

name: Dominant Predator
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Will ignore 50% of the target’s DEF, as well as <color=#1ee600>[Life Barrier]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Poison Cloud]</color> buffs, and effects that redirect attacks, damage, or debuffs to another target. Repeats this attack once if <color=#F3BC02>Packmaster Shy'ek</color> is on the team.

name: Primal Ambition [P]
description:
Increases this Champion’s ATK by 5% when killing an enemy or decapitating a Hydra Head (stacks up to 25%). Increases this Champion’s ATK by 10% when killing an enemy or decapitating a Hydra Head instead if <color=#F3BC02>Packmaster Shy'ek</color> is on the team (stacks up to 50%).

Instantly activates the <color=#1ee600>Dominant Predator</color> skill against a Hydra Head, when an ally is devoured by that Head, if <color=#F3BC02>Packmaster Shy'ek</color> is on the team.

name: Skill 99105 name
description: Skill 8000628 description

name: Bone Club Bash
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

The first hit has a 30% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff for 2 turns. The second hit has a 30% chance of placing a 100% <color=#1ee600>[Heal Reduction]</color> debuff for 2 turns.

name: Unspoken Bonds
description: Places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase SPD]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. Also places а 15% <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff on all allies for 1 turn.

name: Yellowhand Clobber
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Decreases the Turn Meters of all enemies by 15%. 

Has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn.

name: Pastoral Protector [P]
description: Whenever an ally is attacked, fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 5% (once per attacked ally).

name: Breaking Story
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Freeze]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Sleep]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[Fear]</color>, <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color>, or <color=#1ee600>[Petrification]</color> on the target for 1 turn. 

Then places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Explosive Scoop
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Has a 75% chance of stealing all buffs from the target. Also has a 75% chance of stealing 100% of the target's current Turn Meter. Then has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Nullify]</color> debuff and a <color=#1ee600>[Seal]</color> debuff on the target for 2 turns.

<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Has a 25% chance of activating the <color=#1ee600>Explosive Scoop</color> skill on an enemy when they gain an Extra Turn or Instant Turn effect. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: Live on the Scene!
description:
Places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ACC]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Also decreases the Turn Meters of all enemies by 20%. 

Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Ace Reporter [P]
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Decreases all enemies' Turn Meters by 10% whenever an enemy has their skill activated, teams up with allies to attack, gains an Extra Turn or an Instant Turn, has their skills' cooldowns decreased, gets their Shield's value increased, gets their destroyed HP restored, has their HP swapped by allies or by themselves, <color=#1ee600>Evades</color> an enemy effect or skill, has their Turn Meter equalized, or has their HP balanced from a skill. Occurs once per skill. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Whenever enemies remove, transfer, or decrease the duration of any debuff to 0, decreases the Turn Meters of all enemies by 25%. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

description: Skill 8000628 description

name: Boo-Yah!
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

If either hit was critical, places a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Increase ATK]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Express Delivery!
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, has a 75% chance of placing a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff on the target for 2 turns. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Stun]</color> debuff for 1 turn. Will ignore 25% of the target’s RES if the attack is critical. 

Then applies a <color=#1ee600>[Debuff Spread]</color> effect, taking all debuffs from the target and placing them on all enemies. Will ignore 25% of each target’s RES if the initial attack was critical.

name: Shell Cyclone
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Has a 75% chance of placing a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff and a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff for 2 turns. Will ignore 25% of each target’s RES if the attack is critical. 

Then places a <color=#1ee600>[Taunt]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Party Dude [P]
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Has a 15% chance to <color=#1ee600>Evade</color> an enemy skill and all of its accompanying effects. If this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Taunt]</color> buff, the chance to <color=#1ee600>Evade</color> increases to 30%.

Whenever this Champion attacks, any ally <color=#F3BC02>Leonardo</color>s, <color=#F3BC02>Donatello</color>s, <color=#F3BC02>Michelangelo</color>s, and <color=#F3BC02>Raphael</color>s will join in that attack. 

<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff equal to 300% of this Champion’s ATK on this Champion for 1 turn when they receive a hit.

name: Shellshocker
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Decreases the cooldowns of all allies' skills, except this Champion's, by 2 turns. This skill's cooldown cannot be decreased or reset. 

Places a 30% <color=#1ee600>[Increase SPD]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns.

name: Secret of the Ooze
description:
Removes all debuffs from all allies. 

Places a 15% <color=#1ee600>[Continuous Heal]</color> buff and a 25% <color=#1ee600>[Strengthen]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns. 

Also fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 20%.

name: I Got You Bro! [P]
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Whenever this Champion attacks, any ally <color=#F3BC02>Leonardo</color>s, <color=#F3BC02>Donatello</color>s, <color=#F3BC02>Michelangelo</color>s, and <color=#F3BC02>Raphael</color>s will join in that attack. 

<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Whenever an ally is about to receive a fatal hit, this Champion prevents that ally’s death and keeps them alive with 1 HP. Then equalizes that ally’s HP. The HP level of that ally will be brought up to the average HP level of the team. If there are multiple Champions on the team with this skill, only one will activate. This skill will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion, if this particular Champion is dead.

name: New York Slice
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. When counterattacking, will repeat this attack against a random enemy. 

Will ignore 3% of the target’s DEF for each buff on this Champion (stacks up to 15%).

name: Shell Yeah!
description:
Places a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Increase DEF]</color> buff on all allies for 2 turns, and a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Ally Protection]</color> buff on all allies except this Champion for 2 turns. 

Also places an <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buff and a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Turtles Together
description:
Attacks all enemies. The damage inflicted by this skill increases by 5% for each buff on all allies and enemies. 

Removes all buffs from all enemies if this attack kills an enemy. This effect cannot be resisted.

name: Hero in a Half Shell [P]
description:
Places a <color=#1ee600>[Stone Skin]</color> buff on this Champion for 1 turn each time enemy hits drop their HP below 50%. Occurs once per skill. 

Whenever this Champion attacks, any ally <color=#F3BC02>Leonardo</color>s, <color=#F3BC02>Donatello</color>s, <color=#F3BC02>Michelangelo</color>s, and <color=#F3BC02>Raphael</color>s will join in that attack.

name: Sewer Skewer
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Block Revive]</color> debuff if the target is killed. 

Each critical hit fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 10%.

name: Saismic Slam
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Will ignore <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs if attacking under a <color=#1ee600>[Berserk]</color> debuff placed by this Champion. If this Champion is not under a <color=#1ee600>[Berserk]</color> debuff placed by themselves, the damage inflicted against enemies under <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buffs is increased by 50%. 

Each critical hit fills this Champion’s Turn Meter by 10%.

name: Not Today, Knucklehead!
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

Each hit will ignore 20% of the target’s DEF. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff and an <color=#1ee600>[Unkillable]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns if the target is killed. If the target survives, places a <color=#1ee600>[Berserk]</color> debuff on this Champion for 2 turns instead. This debuff cannot be resisted or blocked.

name: NYC Beatdown [P]
description:
Whenever this Champion attacks, any ally <color=#F3BC02>Leonardo</color>s, <color=#F3BC02>Donatello</color>s, <color=#F3BC02>Michelangelo</color>s, and <color=#F3BC02>Raphael</color>s will join in that attack. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Berserk]</color> debuff on this Champion for 1 turn when any Champion dies. 

Has a 20% chance of granting an Extra Turn when attacking under a <color=#1ee600>[Berserk]</color> debuff placed by this Champion.

name: Rage of Saki
description:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. 

The second and third hits of this skill will ignore 5% and 10% of the target's DEF respectively. The second and third hits of this skill will deal 10% and 20% more C. DMG respectively.

name: Shadow Shinobi
description:
Attacks all enemies 2 times. 

Each critical hit decreases the enemy's DEF by 5% (stacks up to 30%). Each critical hit also increases this Champion's MAX HP by 5% (stacks up to 30%). 

Each hit has a 75% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff for 2 turns. This debuff cannot be resisted if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Veil]</color> or a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff.

name: This Is True Ninjutsu!
description:
Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, steals all buffs from a single target enemy. This effect cannot be resisted if this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Veil]</color> or a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff. Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 15% for each buff stolen. 

Will ignore 15% of each enemy's DEF, as well as <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> and <color=#1ee600>[Block Damage]</color> buffs. If this Champion is under a <color=#1ee600>[Veil]</color> or <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff, will ignore 30% of each enemy's DEF instead.

name: Dimensional Tyrant [P]
description:
<color=#1ee600>[Passive Effect]</color>

Decreases all incoming damage by 30%. This damage is split equally among all allies, except this Champion.

Increases this Champion’s damage dealt by 15% for each dead ally.

<color=#1ee600>[Active Effect]</color>

Whenever this Champion loses 20% of their MAX HP in one attack, has a 100% chance to <color=#1ee600>Evade</color> the next attack. When this guaranteed <color=#1ee600>Evade</color> effect activates, places a <color=#1ee600>[Perfect Veil]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns and has a 50% chance of placing a <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff on all enemies for 1 turn. The <color=#1ee600>[True Fear]</color> debuff cannot be resisted.

name: Skill 99805 name
description: Skill 8000628 description

name: Thirsting Sword
description:
Attacks 1 enemy. 

Heals all allies by 5% of their MAX HP. Heals all allies by an additional 5% of their MAX HP if this Champion attacks a target under a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff.

name: Deathplunge
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Heals all allies by 15% of this Champion’s MAX HP. The value of the heal increases by 5% for each <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff on the enemy team. 

If a Champion receives any surplus heal, places a <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> buff on that Champion for 2 turns. The value of the <color=#1ee600>[Shield]</color> is equal to the amount of surplus heal received, up to 30% of the Champion’s MAX HP.

name: All-Consuming Roar
description:
Attacks all enemies. 

Places a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff for 2 turns and a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn on all enemies. 

Also places a <color=#1ee600>[Counterattack]</color> buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

name: Metamorph
description: Transforms this Champion into their Alternate Form. Then grants an Extra Turn.

name: Battle Revelry [P]
description:
Each time this Champion hits an enemy under a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff, increases this Champion’s DEF and HP by 5% (stacks up to 50%). 

When attacked by enemies whose ATK is higher than or equal to their DEF, has a 100% chance to place a 50% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease ATK]</color> debuff for 2 turns. When attacked by enemies whose DEF is higher than their ATK, has a 100% chance to place a 60% <color=#1ee600>[Decrease DEF]</color> debuff for 2 turns instead.

When attacked by enemies under a <color=#1ee600>[Leech]</color> debuff, has a 50% chance to place a <color=#1ee600>[Provoke]</color> debuff for 1 turn.
